name: vect-hack
description: VectHack — NetHack 5.0, Angband 4.2, Larn 12.0, and Umoria 5.7 cores compiled to WebAssembly and rendered as vector graphics
author: Eric Mulvihill <eric.mulvihill@gmail.com>

scripts.serve:www: vite build --base /play/ && node scripts/build/stage-licenses.mjs && node scripts/dev/serve-www.mjs
scripts.test:nethack: npm run test:nethack-boot && npm run test:nethack-persist && npm run test:nethack-save-restore && npm run test:nethack-tabs && npm run test:nethack-autosave
scripts.test:angband: npm run test:angband-boot && npm run test:angband-persist && npm run test:angband-save-restore && npm run test:angband-autosave && npm run test:angband-borg && npm run test:angband-borg-death
scripts.test:larn: npm run test:larn-boot && npm run test:larn-seed && npm run test:larn-repro && npm run test:larn-trace && npm run test:larn-persist && npm run test:larn-save-restore && npm run test:larn-autosave && npm run test:larn-map-contract && npm run test:larn-status && npm run test:larn-savefile && npm run test:larn-gym && npm run test:larn-reflect && npm run test:larn-killer
scripts.test:moria: npm run test:moria-boot && npm run test:moria-play && npm run test:moria-checkpoint-native && npm run test:moria-map-contract && npm run test:moria-persist && npm run test:moria-save-restore && npm run test:moria-tabs && npm run test:moria-autosave && npm run test:moria-overlay && npm run test:moria-build-contract
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:render && npm run test:nethack && npm run test:angband && npm run test:larn && npm run test:moria
scripts.preview: vitest run scripts/dev/scene-preview.test.ts scripts/dev/radar-preview.test.ts && (magick .preview/nethack-scene.ppm .preview/nethack-scene.png 2>/dev/null && echo .preview/nethack-scene.png || echo .preview/nethack-scene.ppm) && (magick .preview/nethack-scene-fp.ppm .preview/nethack-scene-fp.png 2>/dev/null && echo .preview/nethack-scene-fp.png || echo .preview/nethack-scene-fp.ppm) && (magick .preview/angband-scene.ppm .preview/angband-scene.png 2>/dev/null && echo .preview/angband-scene.png || echo .preview/angband-scene.ppm) && (magick .preview/angband-scene-fp.ppm .preview/angband-scene-fp.png 2>/dev/null && echo .preview/angband-scene-fp.png || echo .preview/angband-scene-fp.ppm) && (magick .preview/radar.svg .preview/radar.png 2>/dev/null && echo .preview/radar.png || echo .preview/radar.svg)
